params.val: the holder's moves cannot be redirected (Follow Me, Rage Powder, Lightning Rod, Storm Drain) — they always hit their original target

verified against Showdown data/abilities.ts (propellertail): implemented as move.tracksTarget = true (locks onto the originally-selected target through redirection), except for moves with target type 'scripted' (Counter/Mirror Coat/Metal Burst, which retaliate against whoever hit them and have no fixed target to begin with, so the flag is moot for them).
